definitions.definition: A small flat case containing magnetic tape on two reels, used to record and play back audio and video material.

quote.citation: 2011, Rebekah Modrak, Bill Anthes, Reframing Photography: Theory and Practice:
quote.text: If you need to reload film, the cassette can be rewound slightly by turning the hub located on one end of its spool.

definitions.definition: Any similar small cartridge, such as for a computer disk or cassette air conditioner
(photography) A lightproof container for photographic film.
(genetics) A modular DNA sequence encoding one or more genes for a single biochemical function.
(cycling) A set of sprockets mounted onto a splined shaft on the freehub.
A saggar (ceramic container used in a kiln)
